# Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-83877
Voiceover: A garment record becomes institutional evidence when material, date, maker, identifier, and rights remain attached.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Mary Tavener Holmes, 1983

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CA04-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · TRANSLATE — What does “the vision” mean operationally?. Turn aesthetic direction into testable specifications while preserving the reason behind them: material, construction, tolerance, finish, movement, color, hand, durability, repair, packaging, cost, timing, and acceptable variation.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CA04-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · LOCATE LABOR — Who performs each transformation?. Name the actual employer, worker, contractor, vendor, or licensee where verified; record jurisdiction, role, classification source, wage-and-hour review, safety route, language access, and subcontracting uncertainty. Do not let a purchase order erase people.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CA04-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · ALLOCATE POWER — Who can approve, reject, revise, pause, and be paid?. Bind decisions to thresholds, response times, evidence, escalation, payment milestones, change-order treatment, quality disputes, intellectual-property terms, confidentiality, and termination. “Final approval” must name both subject and consequence.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CA04-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CLOSE THE LOOP — What returns from production to the house?. Capture deviations, defects, worker or supplier feedback, material substitutions, fit outcomes, quantities, waste, cost changes, approvals, corrected specifications, provenance, and archive records so production knowledge can alter the next collection.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S38
Voiceover: Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 establishing a framework for ecodesign requirements for sustainable products is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer
